annotations.title: Check an owned Brand Kit photo for a picture edit

description: Select an owned Brand Kit photo by its exact Library id and updated_at. Poll preparing with the same clientRequestId. People are allowed in image edits. If consentRequired is true, show the preview and ask for one tap using soclo_photo_reference_confirm; this permission is saved once per account. The immutableUrl is an image-edit source, not person-video consent. Approve the generation quote separately.

assetId.description: Exact id of a current owned Library row with kind=brand_asset.

assetVersion.description: Exact updated_at of that same current Library row; do not fabricate or normalize it.

clientRequestId.description: Stable UUID for this exact asset/version and every preparing poll.
